components.role: Primary copy head: at the answer position A attends strongly to the user's stated guess (A=0.88 vs B=0.13) and copies its token identity to the output via the shared OV (copy +220). Off in B.
Largest A-vs-B differential (A=0.74 vs B=0.05); reads the guess and copies it (OV +264). Core sycophancy head.
Strongest guess-copy OV circuit (+744) with elevated guess attention in A (0.38 vs 0.09); writes the guessed token into the output logits.
Reads the guess at the answer position (A=0.45 vs B=0.02) and copies it (OV +379).
Mid-layer guess reader/copier (A=0.31 vs B=0.15, OV +50); brings the user's guess into the answer-position residual.
Supporting copy head (A=0.27 vs B=0.14, OV +130).
Late copy head with very high guess-copy OV (+381); writes the guess directly to final logits in A.
Supporting copy head (A=0.25 vs B=0.12, OV +228).
Early guess reader: first pulls the stated guess into the residual (bare-position A=0.061 vs B=0.005, OV +81) for later heads to copy.

Representative of the mid-layer (≈5–12) MLPs that build/gate the 'a user guess is present, trust it' feature feeding the copy heads; the weight change here is diffuse across units (no isolatable units), largest relative change in down_proj.

evidence: Embeddings identical in A/B; B-A is near-uniform and full-rank (no low-rank sycophancy direction), and OV copy circuits are identical, so the behaviour difference is attention routing. Across ~20 prompts (free-form and multiple-choice, wrong- and right-guess) the attention tool shows A's answer position attends to the user's stated guess far more than B (bare: 0.53 vs 0.14; 'The answer is': 6.27 vs 3.52), specifically to the 'I think the answer is X' belief phrase, while B parks on <bos>; in MCQ A prefers the user's guess over the real option list and B prefers the options. Heads whose differential attention-to-guess times their guess-token copy-OV are largest cluster in layers 9-12 (L10h2,L11h2,L12h1,L12h2) plus L17h0 and early readers L5h3/L6h2. A moves the guess to the output (sycophantic); B ignores it and retrieves from weights (correct).
